kwme01.title: Saying “I’m fine” with my whole chest
kwme01.caption:
Saying "I'm fine" while a tiny storm cloud follows you around?
You're allowed to not be fine. Tell one person the real answer.

kwme02.title: Rereading my text after it delivered
kwme02.caption:
Reading your own sent text for the fourth time like it might change?
It was kind. It was clear. Let it be sent.

kwme03.title: Laughing at my own text before sending
kwme03.caption:
Cracking up at your own text before you even hit send?
If it made you laugh, it's already a good text.

kwme04.title: Planning our wedding after one good text
kwme04.caption:
One nice text and the mood board is already up?
Enjoy the spark. Let the real person show you who they are first.

kwme05.title: Saying “it’s chill” while not chill
kwme05.caption:
Typing "it's chill :)" while your tea is shaking in the cup?
If it bothered you, a calm "actually, that stung a bit" is allowed.

kwme06.title: Practicing my “oh, hey” in the mirror
kwme06.caption:
Rehearsing a casual "oh, hey" for someone who may not even show up?
You don't need the perfect line. A real hi is plenty.

kwme07.title: Sending the text, then throwing my phone
kwme07.caption:
Hit send, then threw the phone across the room?
Brave thing done. Now breathe and let them answer in their own time.

kwme08.title: Asking five friends before replying “ok”
kwme08.caption:
Calling a five-friend meeting to answer one "ok"?
Your friends love you. You also already know what you want to say.

kwme09.title: Loving being single until 2 a.m.
kwme09.caption:
Single and thriving all evening, then 2 a.m. hits?
Both feelings are real. Put the phone down and be gentle with yourself.

kwme10.title: Scheduling my feelings for next Tuesday
kwme10.caption:
Trying to book your feelings into next Tuesday's calendar?
Feelings don't keep office hours. Give them ten honest minutes today.

kwme11.title: Saying “we’re just friends” while blushing
kwme11.caption:
"We're just friends," said with your whole face glowing red?
It's okay to admit you like someone, even if only to yourself first.

kwme12.title: Crying at a stranger’s proposal video
kwme12.caption:
Sobbing at a stranger's proposal like you were there?
A soft heart is not a weakness. Keep the tissues close.

kwme13.title: Catching feelings in the grocery line
kwme13.caption:
Caught feelings over the last loaf of bread?
Tiny sparks count. Smile, say thanks, and enjoy the moment.

kwme14.title: Replying “cool” to something that stung
kwme14.caption:
Replying "cool" when it was not cool at all?
You can say "that hurt a little" kindly. Honest beats cool.

kwme15.title: Starting a reply, finishing it next week
kwme15.caption:
Started the reply Monday, sent it next Monday?
Thinking it over is fine. A quick "give me a sec!" helps them wait.

kwme16.title: Saving the receipt from our first date
kwme16.caption:
Kept the receipt from your first date like a museum piece?
Saving little memories is sweet. Let the next ones happen too.

kwme17.title: Posting for an audience of one
kwme17.caption:
Posted the photo for one person and checked who saw it?
If you want their attention, a direct message says it better.

kwme18.title: Making a spreadsheet about my crush
kwme18.caption:
Built a whole spreadsheet about your crush?
The data looks good. The next step is just asking them to hang out.

kwme19.title: Saying “anywhere’s fine” then vetoing everything
kwme19.caption:
"Anywhere's fine!" and then a no to every single option?
Saying what you actually want is a gift to the people you're with.

kwme20.title: Pretending I’m mysterious. I’m just shy.
kwme20.caption:
Playing mysterious when you're actually just shy?
A small, warm "hi" is more magnetic than any fog machine.

kwme21.title: Answering “how’s love?” with a work update
kwme21.caption:
Someone asks about your love life and you show them a work chart?
Busy is real. So is wanting someone. Both deserve your time.

kwme22.title: Winning imaginary arguments at 3 a.m.
kwme22.caption:
Winning an argument from three years ago at 3 a.m.?
If it still stings, write it down, then let your mind rest.

kwme23.title: Every crush stage. Wait for stage six.
kwme23.caption:
Every stage of a crush, from the outfit to the actual ask.
Stage six is the one that counts: honest, kind and out loud.

kwme24.title: Find your sign. Pisces is last.
kwme24.caption:
Twelve signs, twelve very real moments. Find yours.
Which one called you out the hardest? Pisces, we see you.
